name: TextCursor-TS-TW
title: Text Cursor Trail
blurb: Text characters trail behind the cursor with motion physics.
description: Renders a customizable text/emoji trail that follows pointer movement. Characters spawn at intervals, rotate to face direction of motion, fade and exit.
use_when: Interactive demos, playful hero sections, or engagement-focused pages where cursor trails are memorable.
avoid_when: Dense text pages (distraction); high-traffic sites (per-pointer state overhead).
a11y: Trail overlay; no keyboard interaction. No reduced-motion support.
